final:
-- Pick an element of a non-empty list from an integer seed.
-- Deterministic: the same seed and list always give the same element.
-- Uses no nondet or random.

pick_index(n: int, seed: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0 and out < n
  ex pick_index(3, 7) == 1
  ex pick_index(5, -1) == 4
  seed % n

pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out == xs[pick_index(xs.len(), seed)]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  xs[pick_index(xs.len(), seed)]
